hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels (lines 173-192) checks each reservation input against available_quantity individually and never sums inputs sharing the same (inventory_item, location). Two carts on one server, cart A with 5 x OVS-PIECE and cart B with 3 x OVS-PIECE plus 2 x OVS-TWOPACK (4 WIDGET units), against WIDGET stock 10, should both pass the per-line check once A reserves 5 (3<=5, 4<=5), giving reserved 12 of 10. Expect no_oversell to fail in some runs, and reserved_matches_reservations to pass since the counter tracks the rows.
